result.title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
result.summary: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. TTU requires continuously tracking objects through transformations, identifying new entities, maintaining a state graph of their relationships, and assigning semantic labels to transformations. While foundation models (e.g., SAM 2/3) maintain tracklets through appearance changes, they cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve. Prior work addresses only disassemblies, relying on expensive searches triggered only when tracking fails. We propose Tracking Instances via Proposals and Overlaps (TIPO), a training-free framework that continuously infers transformations via a generate-evaluate-judge pipeline. TIPO generates split and merge proposals from disjoint mask components, scores them against mask-decoder priors using inner and external overlap, and queries an MLLM on the top proposal for visual verification and semantic labeling. To benchmark TTU, we curate Video Instances, States, and Transformation Annotations (VISTA), a dataset including state graphs with 124 assembly and 132 disassembly events across 50 sequences and over 26,000 frames. TIPO achieves state-of-the-art tracking and state-graph accuracy on VISTA, while operating $6\times$ to $15\times$ faster than prior methods. Project page: https://davidegardenal.github.io/tipo-tracking

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「变换跟踪与理解」（TTU）任务及 VISTA 数据集，考察物体经组装与拆解时如何持续跟踪、识别新实体并维护状态图；并给出免训练框架 TIPO，通过分裂/合并提案生成、重叠打分与对 top 提案的 MLLM 视觉核验来更新变换标签。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成–评估–判定」流程与按需查询 MLLM 做视觉核验的机制，可作为核查 LVR 中何时触发证据获取、候选筛选及外部状态更新效率的借鉴线索，但对象级跟踪状态与模型内部 latent 表示仍有距离。
